deferred.detail: The instruction says the supplied source contains a per-round P/K board for this stage (24 teams x 16 matches). No such board exists in the repository, in CORE, or in the task text; only the aggregate rank/total narrative was insufficient to rebuild it. The 24-team Semi Finals field is not the 16-team Finalist list in import-bmps-2024.js, and that list carries no per-round placements or kills.
deferred.requiredToProceed: Provide the 24-team x 16-match P/K board (or any per-round placement/kill table) for BMPS 2024 Semi Finals. Reconstructing the agreed place/elim/total invariants without it would invent roughly 768 cells.
